language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language of the app

approvalTier.title: Approval mode

description.manual: Prompts before file reads and writes; read-only commands run automatically.
description.sandbox: Commands run in the macOS sandbox; file operations still prompt.
description.sandboxWindows: Protects Windows writes and asks before writing outside allowed locations.
description.sandboxLinux: Commands run in the Linux system sandbox and ask for approval when accessing files outside it.
description.off: No prompts, no sandbox — everything runs.

approvalTier.fallbackNotice: Sandbox protection is unavailable (diagnostic: {{code}}). Switched to Manual mode; commands will not run without sandbox protection.

reasons.binaryMissing: Bubblewrap is not installed. Install Bubblewrap, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.pathRejected: No trusted system Bubblewrap was found. Check PATH and confirm the bwrap file is owned by root, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.binaryInvalid: System Bubblewrap is not a valid executable. Reinstall it or repair its permissions, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.versionUnreadable: The Bubblewrap version could not be recognized. Reinstall or upgrade Bubblewrap, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.versionTooOld: Bubblewrap is older than version 0.9.0. Upgrade it, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.requiredFeatureMissing: This Bubblewrap package lacks features required by FutureOS. Upgrade or replace the system package, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.userNamespaceDisabled: Unprivileged user namespaces are disabled. Enable them, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.procMountRestricted: The system does not allow the sandbox to mount a private /proc. Adjust the system or container policy, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.probeTimeout: Bubblewrap detection timed out. Check the system, then restart FutureOS and try again. ({{code}})
reasons.probeFailed: The Bubblewrap sandbox check failed. Run future doctor for details, fix the issue, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.binaryIdentityChanged: The Bubblewrap file changed after detection. Verify the system package, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.probeTransportError: FutureOS could not contact the Agent to check the Linux sandbox. Try again later or restart FutureOS. ({{code}})
reasons.unknown: The Linux sandbox is unavailable. Run future doctor for details, fix the issue, then restart FutureOS. ({{code}})

futureLogin.title: Connect FutureOS
futureLogin.description: The authorization page should have opened in your browser. If it didn't, copy the link to open it manually.
futureLogin.waiting: Once you finish signing in and authorizing in your browser, the connection completes automatically here…
futureLogin.expired: The authorization code has expired, please try again.

reset.switchEnvironmentDescription: Switch the sign-in and API endpoints between production and test. Switching clears the current sign-in and restarts the app automatically; you'll need to sign in again in the new environment.
reset.writeProtectionDescription: Remove folder permissions added by FutureOS for Windows write protection. No files are deleted. If a task is running, wait for it to finish before resetting.
reset.writeProtectionFailed: Reset is not available right now. Wait for running tasks to finish, then try again.
reset.clearDataDescription: Clear the GUI local database and temporary workspace (chats, background programs, review records, etc.); the app restarts automatically when done. Sign-in and provider settings are unaffected. This action cannot be undone.
reset.confirmClear: Clear all local data and restart?
